ShortenedLink.title: ShortenedLink
ShortenedLink.description: A validated destination link mapped to a unique short code or custom alias, storing only routing metadata and an aggregate click counter.

code.description: Case-preserved short code or custom alias.

originalUrl.description: Normalized safe destination URI (HTTP, HTTPS, mailto, tel, sms, magnet, ftp, ws, or app deep link).

protocol.description: Lowercase URI scheme without trailing colon.

clicks.description: Aggregate redirect count initialized to 0 and incremented atomically by +1.

lastAccessedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent redirect, or null before first click.

/links/{linkId}.description: Publicly resolvable short link records keyed by lowercase code/alias.
